changes.reason: Document exact audited-resume guards, reviewed plan, native staging exceptions, fixed rerun schedule and distinction from partial selections.
Record actual per-equation viewport eligibility with weak references, observation/TeX resets and prior visibility/resource history for the native probe.
Use recorded per-equation viewport history and resource timing; do not infer never-visible state from a panel that is currently offscreen. Other probes are unchanged.
Install conformance-only visibility observation before app.start so restored cards are audited from their first mount.
Export five existing gate/environment/claims helpers for the audited continuation; function bodies, gate commands and default behavior are unchanged.
Bind full-parent source, tarball, lock, history and native identities; reuse only passing unchanged gates and rerun all six fixed affected gates with explicit provenance.
Retain source gate timestamps, execution/reusedFrom and compact resumed pipeline provenance when deriving preview evidence; metadata only.
Exercise viewport eligibility and observation lifecycle with explicit observer test doubles; preserve native lazy-render checks.
Wait for viewport resize metadata and its queued rendered frame together; retain all size, suspension and frame-count assertions.
Exercise scope/hash/archive/partial-parent/raw-budget refusals, inherited provenance and real preview derivation with labelled browser discovery test doubles.
